## Projects

- **Thiup** (https://thiup.com/) — anonymous, open-source social network
  focused on freedom of expression. In production.
- **Telephone API** (https://telephone.soyteo.co/docs) — open-source API
  built on Twilio that returns detailed information about phone numbers.
  In production. Source: https://github.com/SirRiuz/Telephone
- **Vivaldi Math Solver** — open-source scientific calculator for Android:
  solves complex operations, graphs functions in 2D/3D and shows
  step-by-step solutions. In production.
- **Track** (https://github.com/SirRiuz/Strack) — open-source price tracker
  for stores like MercadoLibre, Amazon and eBay. Archived.
